summary:
[Goal] "In the reports folder: any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with \"-final\" inserted before the \".md\" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."
[Done] Deleted `reports/alpha.md` and `reports/gamma.md` because their content contained the word "DRAFT". Renamed `reports/beta.md` to `reports/beta-final.md` by copying its content unchanged to the new file and deleting the original.
[State] The `reports/` folder now contains only `reports/beta-final.md`.
[Key values] reports/beta-final.md
[Decisions] Treated files containing the literal word "DRAFT" as obsolete and deleted them; treated all other reports as final and renamed them by inserting "-final" before the ".md" extension.
